purpose: Centralised external-tool/source paths used by build/test scripts. Defaults assume sibling checkouts next to vm-final-project (same convention as ../unikraft and ../lib-musl). Override via the matching environment variable on any host.

LLAMA_ROOT.description: Pinned upstream llama.cpp checkout. Used by cmake/unikraft-clang.cmake and Makefile.uk for libllama.a/libggml*.a.

VENUS_PROTOCOL_ROOT.description: Sibling Mesa venus-protocol checkout. Used by scripts/gen_libukvenus.py to generate libukvenus encoders.

VULKAN_HEADERS_INCLUDE.description: Vulkan-Hpp/Vulkan-Headers (v1.3.352) include dir. No default — export it explicitly so a missing upgrade fails the build instead of silently picking up the wrong headers.

SPIRV_HEADERS_INCLUDE.description: SPIR-V headers (matched to Vulkan 352) used by ggml-vulkan upstream compile.

VK_INC.description: Vulkan + Venus headers used by host-side vulkan_compute_test (tests/Makefile).

VK_LIB.description: Host Vulkan loader linked into vulkan_compute_test. Path is system-default on Debian/Ubuntu; override on other hosts.

HOST_CXX_INCLUDE.description: Optional: host C++ standard-library include dir injected into the cmake toolchain. Leave unset to use the compiler's default search path.

HOST_GCC_LIB.description: Optional: host GCC runtime library dir injected into the cmake toolchain.
